title: notogramme japonica
intro: Notogramme japonica, commonly known as Notogramme, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Notogramme japonica include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Notogramme japonica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
